caption: save this. january has one date worth planning a conversation around: jan 10, when mars stops in virgo.

slides.headline: new year, new sky. what's coming in *january*
slides.dek: eight dates to put in your calendar before you text anyone

slides.headline: new moon in *capricorn*: the real new year
slides.body: jan 1 is a date. the new moon is the sky's reset. astrologers read it as the night to pick one plan and mean it.

slides.headline: *mars* stops and turns backwards in *virgo*
slides.body: from earth, mars seems to reverse as we overtake it. it stays retrograde into spring. read it as redo season, not start season.

slides.headline: *venus* goes honest: flirting gets blunt
slides.body: venus leaves scorpio for sagittarius on jan 7. good month to say what you want on the first date, not the fifth.

slides.headline: *aquarius* season, and an eclipse right behind it
slides.body: the sun reaches aquarius on jan 20 and meets pluto on jan 25. an annular solar eclipse lands in aquarius on feb 6.

slides.headline: full moon in *leo*: the month's loudest night
slides.body: astrologers read leo full moons as the push to be seen. say the thing you've been rehearsing in the shower.

slides.headline: if you remember one date: *jan 10*
slides.body: mars stops. don't start the fight you'll have to redo. new year, new deck. there's always an 11:11.
